items.title: Automate toll-free number registrations at scale with AWS End User Messaging
items.summary: Learn how to automate the full toll-free number (TFN) registration lifecycle with a serverless architecture. Using AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, and a human-in-the-loop rejection pattern, this solution reduces each registration to a single API call and tracks the multi-day carrier review at zero compute cost.
items.creator: Rommel Sunga
